title: The Duchess
subtitle: Independent
description: The Duchess was a democratically elected regent on the planet Plazir-15. Alongside her husband, the former Imperial Captain Bombardier, they ruled this peaceful and productive land. When visited upon by The Mandalorian Din Djarin and Bo-Katan Kryze, she hired them to help solve her planet's Droid problems and befriended the youngling Grogu in the process.
